The series limit of the Lyman series corresponds to the transition from \( n = \infty \) to \( n = 1 \). Using the Rydberg formula \( 1/\lambda = R_H (1 - 0) \), with \( R_H \approx 1.097373 \times 10^7 \, \text{m}^{-1} \), the wavelength is \( \lambda \approx 91.17 \, \text{nm} \). The energy is \( E = hc/\lambda \approx 13.6 \, \text{eV} \), the ionization energy of hydrogen. Among the given options, 91.17 nm matches choice A.

ANSWER: A
